name: Leverage Shares 2X Long FN Daily ETF
name_en: Leverage Shares 2X Long FN Daily ETF
desc: It invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of the Underlying Security, on a daily basis, consistent with the fund’s investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
